REAL LIFE / REAL CONFIDENCE
MORE THAN A DENTAL PROCEDURE
The best result is getting your normal life back.

Missing teeth and unstable dentures can change how you eat, speak and socialize. Implant treatment is designed to create a stable foundation for a smile that feels more natural.

“I want to order what I want, smile in every photo and stop worrying about my teeth.”
Eat
Enjoy more of the foods you love.
Smile
Feel comfortable in photos again.
Live
Stop planning around your teeth.
IMPLANT SOLUTIONS
One goal. A treatment plan built for you.

The right solution depends on the number of missing teeth, the health of your remaining teeth, your bone structure and what you want from your new smile.

01 / SINGLE
Single Dental Implant

Replace one missing tooth with an implant-supported restoration designed to look and function naturally.

DISCUSS YOUR OPTIONS →
02 / MULTIPLE
Multiple Dental Implants

Restore several missing teeth with a stable solution designed around function, comfort and appearance.

DISCUSS YOUR OPTIONS →
03 / FULL ARCH
Full-Arch / All-on-4®

A fixed full-arch option for patients with extensive tooth loss, failing teeth or uncomfortable dentures.

EXPLORE FULL-ARCH CARE →
A new smile should fit into your life—not the other way around.
FULL-ARCH IMPLANT SOLUTIONS
When you are ready to leave failing teeth behind.

For qualifying patients, full-arch implant treatment can replace an entire row of missing or failing teeth with a fixed implant-supported restoration.

✓ Designed for extensive tooth loss
✓ Stable alternative to removable dentures for qualifying patients
✓ Digitally planned around your anatomy and smile
✓ Customized final restoration after healing
TALK ABOUT FULL-ARCH OPTIONS
YOUR TREATMENT JOURNEY
Clear answers before treatment begins.

A structured process helps you understand your options, your treatment plan and what to expect from one stage to the next.

01
Consultation + 3D Imaging

We evaluate your oral health, goals, bone structure and existing teeth.

02
Personalized Planning

Your team maps the surgical and restorative needs before treatment begins.

03
Implant Placement

Implants are positioned according to your plan, with provisional teeth when appropriate.

04
Final Smile

After healing, your restoration is created for function, comfort and aesthetics.

PEOPLE TAKING CARE OF PEOPLE
A team that understands this is a big decision.

Dr. Alan Meskin is an NYU-trained prosthodontist specializing in dental implants, implant restoration, full-mouth reconstruction and cosmetic smile design. He earned his DDS from NYU College of Dentistry in 2019 and completed his prosthodontics specialty certificate at NYU in 2022. His approach is patient-first and detail-driven, with digital planning and restorations designed to look and function naturally.

COMMON QUESTIONS
Know what to expect.

Your consultation is where the team can determine what applies to your specific situation.

ASK US YOUR QUESTIONS →
How do I know if I am a candidate for dental implants?

Candidacy depends on your oral health, overall health, bone structure and treatment goals. A clinical exam and 3D imaging help the team determine your options.

Can implants replace an entire arch of teeth?
What if I have been told I do not have enough bone?
